summary: xAI released grok-imagine-video-1.5-preview, an image-to-video model available via the xAI API that turns a still image and prompt into up to 720p cinematic video clips.

practices.reason: A new image-to-video generation capability is now available via API, relevant to teams building multimodal or media-generation features but with no benchmarked performance claims to act on directly.
practices.quote: grok-imagine-video-1.5-preview turns a single still image into fluid, cinematic video.
